pause releases the prior scheduler lease and restart reconstructs the review queue from the store
resume rechecks authoritative registry identity, expiry and revocation before state mutation
resume creates a new fenced lease and old worker mutations fail closed
registry revocation creates an append-only invalidation receipt and blocks resume
